recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Bundle.signature on the Documents page unless a later final work-group decision reverses the Bundle.signature deprecation; any future broad rewrite of Signing Bundles should proceed under separate follow-up issues such as FHIR-53914/FHIR-54082.
issue_request: FHIR-46789 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested removing the problematic Document Structure sentence that tied document signatures to a listed attester, XML KeyInfo, and an attester Bundle.entry.fullUri, and replacing the local guidance with a shorter reference to digital signature guidance.
initial_application: The issue was applied in source/documents.html by 44d4699f20a0d3cc55144e2b22bd726e4d2b48fc, which removed the listed-attester/KeyInfo/fullUri sentence and inserted the Jira resolution's Bundle.signature wording. It was then adjusted by f06748cde92aa18ad0830b9f43fbc39639d38026, also explicitly tagged FHIR-46789, to remove the Bundle.signature mention while preserving the Documents page pointer to the digital signatures page.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists documents.html as the current Documents page, so source/documents.html is active build source for the Related URL. Later R6 signature work deprecated Bundle.signature in source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml and source/signatures.html, and FHIR-51099, already represented on the combined branch, confirms the applied decision to use Provenance-based Bundle signatures rather than promoting Bundle.signature. FHIR-53914 remains Triaged/Unresolved as a broader follow-up on Signing Bundles wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source no longer contains the problematic KeyInfo/fullUri/attester recommendation and points readers to the active signatures page, which now carries the current Bundle-signing details.
